text: おれを　おこらせた　おまえは　ロケットだんの　ブラック　リストに　のるぜ

structure.jp: おれを　おこらせた　おまえは
ロケットだんの　ブラック　リストに

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おれを　おこらせた　おまえ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put right before a word describes that word. おれを　おこらせた　おまえ = 'you who made me angry'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: The せる ending on a verb means making someone do it. おこる is 'get angry', so おこらせた = 'made (me) angry'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, tough-guy way of stressing what you say. のるぜ = 'you're going on it, I tell you!'
